description: Manually check active auto-crosspost source accounts for new native posts and mirror any eligible ones immediately. Subject to a 5-minute cooldown per source account and plan limits.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

ruleId.description: Check only this active rule’s source account. Leave out to check all active sources.

sourceAccountId.description: Check only this watched source account id. Respects the 5-minute manual cooldown per source.

name: crossposts_run
title: Check auto-crosspost sources now
